info.name: Afero Cloud Firmware OTA API
OTA
Retrieve partner firmware types

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

items.docs: Retrieves the firmware types defined for the partner.

info.name: Create a partner firmware type

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

items.docs: Creates a new partner firmware type. Firmware types categorize firmware; platform firmware types occupy 1-100 and MCU firmware types 101-200.

info.name: Retrieve a firmware type by type

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: type
params.description: The firmware type. Platform firmware types are 1-100; MCU firmware types are 101-200.

items.docs: Retrieves the partner firmware type identified by the given type number.

info.name: Update a partner firmware type

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: type
params.description: The firmware type. Platform firmware types are 1-100; MCU firmware types are 101-200.

items.docs: Updates the name and description of a partner firmware type.

info.name: Retrieve firmware images from the pool

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tags on which to filter.

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based index of the page to retrieve.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of elements per page. Default page size is 50.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field and sort direction; e.g. `updatedTimestamp`, `description`.

items.docs: Retrieves a paged result set of firmware images in the partner firmware pool.

info.name: Create a firmware record in the firmware pool

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

items.docs: Creates a new firmware record in the partner firmware image pool. The optional `associations` map keys are partner IDs and its values are arrays of device type IDs; associations can be created or deleted at any time after the pool image exists.

info.name: Upload a firmware binary to a temporary location

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

items.docs: Uploads a firmware file to a temporary location, either as a raw file stream (`application/octet-stream`) or as a browser-style upload (`multipart/form-data`). The returned `value` is the file identifier of the uploaded file — the SHA-256 hash of the file.

info.name: Move a binary into the firmware repository

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

items.docs: Moves an uploaded file from the temporary location into the permanent firmware image repository. Send the response body of uploadFirmwareBinary as the payload. The response `value` is the repository URL of the firmware binary, which must be used to update the firmware pool record — otherwise the OTA service cannot send updates.

info.name: Retrieve pool firmware images of a type

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: type
params.description: The firmware type. Platform firmware types are 1-100; MCU firmware types are 101-200.

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tags on which to filter.

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based index of the page to retrieve.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of elements per page. Default page size is 50.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field and sort direction; e.g. `updatedTimestamp`, `description`.

items.docs: Retrieves a paged result set of pool firmware images of a specific firmware type.

info.name: Check whether a pool firmware image exists

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: type
params.description: The firmware type. Platform firmware types are 1-100; MCU firmware types are 101-200.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the firmware image.

params.name: version
params.description: The version string of the firmware image.

params.name: excludeFirmwareImageId
params.description: The ID of a record to exclude from the check.

items.docs: Checks whether a firmware image with the given type, name and version string already exists in the pool. `excludeFirmwareImageId` lets a client exclude the record it is about to update.

info.name: Retrieve device type associations of a pool firmware image

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: type
params.description: The firmware type. Platform firmware types are 1-100; MCU firmware types are 101-200.

params.name: versionNumber
params.description: The globally unique, platform-generated version number of the firmware image.

items.docs: Retrieves all device type associations of the given pool firmware image.

info.name: Update a firmware image in the pool

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: type
params.description: The firmware type. Platform firmware types are 1-100; MCU firmware types are 101-200.

params.name: versionNumber
params.description: The globally unique, platform-generated version number of the firmware image.

items.docs: Updates the name, description, version string, binary URL and tags of a pool firmware image.

info.name: Retrieve firmware images associated with a device type

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: deviceTypeId
params.description: The device type ID.

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tags on which to filter.

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based index of the page to retrieve.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of elements per page. Default page size is 50.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field and sort direction; e.g. `updatedTimestamp`, `description`.

items.docs: Retrieves a paged result set of firmware image records associated with a device type. Records of type 4 (DEVICE_DESCRIPTION) carry the two additional fields `deviceDescriptionId` and `deviceProfileId`.

info.name: Associate a firmware image with a device type

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: deviceTypeId
params.description: The device type ID.

items.docs: Creates an association between a generic firmware image record in the firmware pool and a specific device type, so the image becomes eligible for OTA. `versionNumber` is required. Afero recommends sending the object returned by one of the firmware pool GET endpoints unmodified — modifying it causes errors and prevents OTAs from succeeding.

info.name: Retrieve device type firmware images by firmware type

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: deviceTypeId
params.description: The device type ID.

params.name: type
params.description: The firmware type. Platform firmware types are 1-100; MCU firmware types are 101-200.

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tags on which to filter.

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based index of the page to retrieve.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of elements per page. Default page size is 50.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field and sort direction; e.g. `updatedTimestamp`, `description`.

items.docs: Retrieves a paged result set of firmware image records for a device type filtered to one firmware type.

info.name: Retrieve a device type firmware image by type and version number

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: deviceTypeId
params.description: The device type ID.

params.name: type
params.description: The firmware type. Platform firmware types are 1-100; MCU firmware types are 101-200.

params.name: versionNumber
params.description: The globally unique, platform-generated version number of the firmware image.

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based index of the page to retrieve.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of elements per page. Default page size is 50.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field and sort direction; e.g. `updatedTimestamp`, `description`.

items.docs: Retrieves the single firmware image record associated with a device type for the given firmware type and version number.

info.name: Dissociate a firmware image from a device type

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: deviceTypeId
params.description: The device type ID.

params.name: type
params.description: The firmware type. Platform firmware types are 1-100; MCU firmware types are 101-200.

params.name: versionNumber
params.description: The globally unique, platform-generated version number of the firmware image.

items.docs: Dissociates a firmware image from a device type. NOTE: the Afero docs page heading names this operation DELETE while the HTTP METHOD line on the same section reads PUT — the heading is used here and the discrepancy is recorded in the API Evangelist review.

info.name: Push a firmware image to a device

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

params.name: deviceTypeId
params.description: The device type ID.

params.name: firmwareImageId
params.description: The ID of the firmware image to push to a device.

items.docs: Pushes a firmware image to a target device. The payload `value` is the device ID of the target device.

info.name: Retrieve all firmware tags

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The partner ID.

items.docs: Retrieves all firmware tags defined for the partner.
